Find creators at the moment their current selling setup breaks—not just by audience size.

Topmate is especially suited to experts selling 1:1 calls, webinars, cohorts, bundles, and
digital products, so prioritize career coaches, AI/data/software educators, study-abroad
advisors, product/design mentors, finance/marketing experts, and founders.

Best places to source them:

- Competitor bio-link pages: Search public Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X profiles
  linking to Calendly, Beacons, Stan, Gumroad, Kajabi, Teachable, Graphy, or Google Forms.
  They have already committed to selling—your highest-intent pool.

- LinkedIn: Newsletter authors, "Top Voice" creators, career coaches, webinar hosts, and
  professionals posting job-search or upskilling advice.

- Instagram: Reels creators offering career guidance, study abroad, fitness, finance,
  language learning, astrology, and creator education.

- YouTube: Tutorial and education channels with paid communities, course waitlists, or
  coaching in descriptions/pinned comments.

- Communities: Cohort-based course alumni groups, bootcamp mentors, no-code/AI communities,
  professional Slack/Discord groups, and creator-manager agencies.

The strongest public signals to act on:

| What you see | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| "DM me for mentorship/pricing" | They are manually handling sales and scheduling. |
| A Calendly + payment-link + Zoom stack | They have a fragmented workflow to replace. |
| "Cohort starts soon," "waitlist open," or "webinar registration" | They are actively selling now. |
| "My bookings are hard to manage" / "missed DMs" | The workaround has visibly failed. |
| Moving away from another tool or complaining about fees | A migration opportunity. |
| Selling templates, guides, or consultations separately | A natural fit for a unified storefront. |

Start with three focused lead lists of 100 each:

1. Competitor-link creators
2. "DM for mentorship" creators without a booking page
3. Creators launching a cohort or webinar in the next 30 days

Avoid targeting anonymous/personal distress posts or trying to connect pseudonymous
accounts to real identities. Focus on clear, public business offers.

A simple outreach angle: "You're already selling [calls/cohorts/products], but your
audience has to navigate multiple links. I can show you how to put booking, payments, and
products into one creator page."
